cases.proposal_summary: Collect both airport guests in one trip using Pat's car, on mapped routes that the disruptions do not touch, and finish it well before 14:00. Pat arrives at W (Wedding venue) at 12:00 with a 5-seat car. Pat drives W→B (40 min) and gets to B (Boston Airport) about 12:40, after Jamie lands at 12:30. Pat picks up Alex (landed 11:00) and Jamie, then drives B→T (30 min) to reach T (Tailor shop) about 13:10, before it closes at 14:00. Pat then drives T→W (15 min) and arrives about 13:25 plus time spent at the tailor. That leaves more than 90 minutes before photo_time 15:00. This avoids the hotel-church closure (13:00 for 39 min) and the airport-hotel delay (+17 min from 14:00). It also avoids the short-sighted option of sending a vehicle for Alex at 11:00, which would need a second airport trip near or after 14:00, when the delay starts. The fleet vehicles (van, car1, car2) stay as backups because their start points are not in the travel-time table. Any use of them must allow for the closure and treat the 17-min delay as continuing.
